problem_type: Archived plan status is mistaken for current fork work
symptom: The local delivery ledger and message reminder count324 archived upstream plans as current debt even after physical archive migration.
direct_cause: All collected plan roots feed open-status filtering without a current-versus-archive partition.
class_root: Historical document status is used as current work identity without checking the owning plan namespace.
internal_only_reason: This is a repository-owned document and Git hook path, decided by the tracked migration rather than external library behavior.
invariants: Only documents in docs/plan may contribute current fork debt.
Archived documents remain scanned and indexed with their original status untouched.
generality_proof: All three readers partition through currentPlanDocuments before counting or rendering current debt. A renderer regression mixes live and archived pending plans; CLI brief verifies the actual archive corpus contributes no current task.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Partition current fork plan ownership before status-based current-debt decisions.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Uses currentPlanDocuments before current debt selection.
Uses currentPlanDocuments before current debt selection.
Uses currentPlanDocuments before current debt selection.

recurrence.reason: Every archived pending plan can be miscounted by each status-only reader.
same_class_scan: door-map OPEN_STATUSES --roots=scripts --include-tests:494files,one reader file,three status-debt decisions.
Inspected render,brief and CLI summary paths, as well as collectPlanDocuments historical roots.
RED regression mixes one current and two archived pending plans; old renderer reports three instead of one.

prevention.invariant: Current debt always partitions by current plan ownership before reading pending statuses.
prevention.failure_mode: Archive paths cannot enter current task tables or reminders even when their historical status says pending.
prevention.strategy: Route renderer,brief and command summaries through currentPlanDocuments; retain full archive corpus for historical indexes.

legacy_paths.rationale: Replace unpartitioned status selection in each existing entry point with one current-plan partition.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No dependency upgrade owns this repository filename; existing Node/Git invocation is retained.

migration: Preserve raw archived statuses and indexes; only current work ownership changes. Rebuild the ignored local ledger and brief.
residual_risks: An archived proposal must be explicitly moved back into the current plan namespace to become an active fork task.
